none: PAS CAM-D604D7: Roman Coin : Copper-alloy Nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine. Mint is uncertain, c.AD330-340, (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads - . Reverse shows Victory standing on prow. Obverse shows [helmeted bust left]. Obverse legend reads [CONSTANTINOPOLIS]. Die axis is uncertain, weight is 2.02g, diameter is 14.16mm
